checks.name: pencil strokes are signed as the learner; one that starts on a card is anchored to it
an assistant drawing cannot be signed as the learner and is shown dashed and labelled
leaving the pencil settles exactly one bounded summary without points
dragging the card carries its annotation live and commits a single card move
"Borrar mis trazos" removes only the learner layers in one undoable transaction
deleting a card removes its annotations with it, and undo restores both
a short click on a cell toggles it without Interactuar and without moving the card
tool shortcuts and Space typed on a focused cell stay in the sequencer
a drag that starts on a cell moves the card and does not toggle the cell
with the pencil active the grid is drawing surface: no toggle, and the stroke is anchored to the sequencer card
listening is credited to the music that sounded: edit then immediate pause is unheard; a full cycle of the final pattern is heard
